crops.title: THE HANDWRITTEN SIGN
crops.body: The yellow legal pad carries the moment's two-word message. Its ordinary paper and improvised lettering are central to the real stunt, bringing a personal appeal into a televised policy hearing.
crops.grounding: Visually inspected unchanged native artwork; no invented objects.

crops.title: THE NO SIGNS PLAQUE
crops.body: This invented wall fixture makes the raised sign a visual joke about the room's rules. It is illustrative staging, not a claim that this plaque hung at the hearing.
crops.grounding: Visually inspected unchanged native artwork; no invented objects.

crops.title: THE REPORT HEADING
crops.body: MONETARY POLICY REPORT identifies the business of Yellen's appearance. The drawn document is a contextual prop, not a facsimile of her papers or evidence that she wrote the annotations.
crops.grounding: Visually inspected unchanged native artwork; no invented objects.

crops.title: THE ROUNDED PRICE NOTE
crops.body: BTC approximately $2,400 evokes a reported price that afternoon. The amount is rounded for the illustration and does not establish Bitcoin's price at the instant the sign appeared.
crops.grounding: Visually inspected unchanged native artwork; no invented objects.

crops.title: THE 16 BTC FLASHFORWARD
crops.body: This small annotation points to the original sign's 2024 winning auction bid. It deliberately reaches forward seven years; it is not a note made at the 2017 hearing.
crops.grounding: Visually inspected unchanged native artwork; no invented objects.
